definition.name: Lower Parking Surface
definition.description: Set the parking surface to -7300: lower the 261 parking bays by 150 mm, extend the 87 wall bases down 150 mm, lower the base of the Parking and Ramp rooms 150 mm, and extend the Basement 2 plan view range down 200 mm so the bays stay visible. Doors, elevators and stairs stay at -7150.
